purpose: Preserve original causal onset/offset live runtime alongside best verified offline S80 MIDI scoring. Never imply offline accuracy or noncausal 5-second lookahead is achieved in Live.
live_sidecar_consumes: Externally predicted monotonically timestamped K0..K6 decisions + exactly K MIDI pitches + independent NoteOff IDs
protection_rules: No modification to S80 predictions or selected model weights
Never compute K from number of MIDI peaks
For each prediction source event: exactly K MIDI NoteOn (K0 emits zero)
Allow sustain and NoteOff during K0
On new attack of same MIDI pitch, send NoteOff before retrigger NoteOn
Reject missing K/pitch inputs; fail closed instead of inventing predicted notes
Live MIDI sidecar cannot claim S80/S422 offline scores until causal end-to-end benchmark
